title: User Login Success
description: Verify that a user can successfully login with valid credentials and receive a JWT token.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter valid username and password.
Click on the login button.
Verify login is successful and JWT token is received.

title: User Login Failure with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify that login fails when invalid username or password is provided.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid username or password.
Click the login button.
Confirm that login fails and an appropriate error message is shown.

title: Role-Based Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users with different roles have correct access to user and device management panels.

steps.description: Login as an admin user.
Verify admin user can access user and device management panels.
Logout.
Login as a regular user.
Verify regular user cannot access user and device management panels.

title: Dashboard Loading Performance
description: Validate that the real-time dashboard loads within 2 seconds and charts update within 100 milliseconds.

steps.description: Login and navigate to the dashboard page.
Measure and confirm page load time is under 2 seconds.
Verify that chart updates occur within 100 milliseconds upon receiving new data.

title: Dashboard Customization with Drag-and-Drop
description: Verify that users can customize dashboard layout by dragging and dropping widgets.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard page.
Switch to Custom view mode.
Drag a widget to a different position in the grid layout.
Confirm the widget position changes accordingly.
Reload the dashboard page.
Verify that the customized layout persists after reload.

title: Real-Time Data Display for Active Power
description: Check that real-time active power data is correctly displayed and updated via WebSocket.

steps.description: Open dashboard containing the Active Power widget.
Verify the active power gauge is visible.
Simulate WebSocket data push of updated active power values.
Confirm the active power gauge updates correspondingly within 100 milliseconds.

title: 3-Phase Voltage Display and Phase Analysis
description: Verify that 3-phase voltage levels display correctly and phase analysis charts update on click.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard with Voltage widget.
Verify that 3-phase voltage values are displayed with correct units.
Click on each voltage phase to open analysis charts.
Confirm charts load and display historical voltage trends.

title: Energy Cost Monitoring and Historical Data Accuracy
description: Verify that energy cost widget displays current cost accurately and historical charts reflect correct past data.

steps.description: Open dashboard with Energy Cost widget.
Check the current energy cost value matches expected calculations.
Switch to historical view in the widget.
Verify historical cost charts load and display correct past data trends.

title: Device Registration Workflow
description: Test the ESP32 device registration process from the admin panel.

steps.description: Login as an admin user.
Navigate to device management panel.
Register a new ESP32 device with all required fields.
Confirm the device appears in the device list with correct details.

title: Firmware OTA Update Process
description: Validate that firmware over-the-air update can be triggered and completed successfully on registered devices.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to device management.
Select a registered device and initiate firmware OTA update.
Verify update status is shown and the device reports successful update completion.

title: Device Connection Status Monitoring
description: Ensure device connection status is accurately reported and updated in the device management panel.

steps.description: Open device management panel.
Verify connection status (online/offline) is displayed for each device.
Simulate device disconnect and reconnect.
Confirm connection status updates correctly near real-time.

title: Energy Accumulation Data Accuracy and Display
description: Verify cumulative energy consumption values and associated charts accurately accumulate data over time.

steps.description: Open dashboard with Energy Accumulation widget.
Verify displayed cumulative energy usage is correct according to simulated input data.
View Energy Accumulated Chart for historical data.
Confirm chart reflects long term accumulation trends without data loss.

title: Statistics Panel Comparison Metrics Verification
description: Test that statistical summaries and peak usage data display accurate computed values and percentages.

steps.description: Access Statistics panel on the dashboard.
Check that usage summaries and peak values match expected calculations from input data.
Validate comparison percentages and data ranges are correctly displayed.

title: Real-Time Data Ingestion Via Backend HTTP POST
description: Verify that backend correctly receives ESP32 power meter data via HTTP POST and stores it in InfluxDB.

steps.description: Simulate ESP32 device sending measurement data via HTTP POST to the backend.
Verify the backend service accepts data, returns success response.
Check that the data is accurately stored in InfluxDB time-series database.

title: Internationalization Language Switching and Persistence
description: Validate English and Thai language switching capabilities and that selected preference persists across sessions.

steps.description: Access the language selection option on the UI.
Switch language from English to Thai.
Confirm all UI text, date, time, and currency formats display correctly in Thai.
Reload or log back into the system.
Verify the language preference remains set to Thai.

title: Theme Toggle and Persistence Between Light and Dark Modes
description: Verify that users can toggle between light and dark themes and their choice persists on reload/login.

steps.description: Navigate to theme toggle control.
Switch from Light theme to Dark theme.
Confirm UI updates styles accordingly without visual glitches.
Reload the application or log out and log in again.
Ensure the selected Dark theme persists across sessions.

title: Data Accuracy Verification Against Simulated Meter Readings
description: Confirm that displayed electrical parameters (voltage, current, power factor, energy) achieve a 99.9% accuracy match to simulated physical meter readings.

steps.description: Inject known simulated data values matching physical meter readings into the backend.
Load dashboard widgets displaying respective parameters.
Verify displayed values differ from simulated physical readings by no more than 0.1%.

title: User Management CRUD Operations
description: Test Create, Read, Update, and Delete operations for user management via admin panel.

steps.description: Login as admin and open user management panel.
Create a new user with valid details.
Verify new user appears in the user list.
Update existing user details.
Confirm changes are saved and reflected correctly.
Delete a user.
Verify the user is removed from the list and cannot login.

title: System Uptime and Concurrent Device Support
description: Verify system maintains 99.5% uptime and supports up to 100 concurrent ESP32 devices sending data.

steps.description: Simulate connections from 100 ESP32 devices sending data at expected rates.
Verify the system accepts all connections without degradation.
Monitor uptime and confirm it meets or exceeds 99.5% during test duration.

title: Security Verification for HTTPS and JWT Authentication
description: Confirm that all communication uses HTTPS and JWT tokens are required and validated for protected resources.

steps.description: Attempt to access dashboard and device management endpoints via HTTP.
Verify HTTP requests are rejected or redirected to HTTPS.
Perform login to receive JWT token.
Attempt to access protected endpoints without JWT token.
Confirm access is denied.
Use an expired or invalid JWT token to access endpoints.
Confirm token is rejected and access denied.

title: Responsive UI on Browsers and Mobile Devices
description: Ensure that the user interface displays and functions correctly on latest two versions of major browsers and common mobile devices.

steps.description: Open the dashboard and admin panels on Chrome latest and previous version.
Verify all UI elements render correctly without visual issues.
Repeat testing on Firefox, Edge, and Safari latest two versions.
Confirm consistent functionality and layout across all browsers.
Test UI on iOS and Android mobile devices using supported browsers.
Ensure responsiveness of layout and interactive components work smoothly.
